title: ReFabricated
description: The ultimate Vanilla+ upgrade for your survival world. Refabricated seamlessly blends massive performance boosts and stunning visual enhancements with essential quality-of-life tools for the perfect Minecraft experience.
body:
# ReFabricated
The only Vanilla+ modpack you need to perfect your survival experience. Built entirely client-side, ReFabricated focuses on massive performance gains, beautiful visual tweaks, and essential quality-of-life tools—all without changing the core game.

## Key Features
**_Elite Performance:_** Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore for maximum FPS and incredibly low RAM usage.

_**Stunning Visuals:**_ Built-in Iris Shader support, smooth physics for player cosmetics, and clean connected glass textures.

_**Smart Utilities:**_ Quick inventory sorting, Litematica building tools, AppleSkin hunger displays, and advanced camera controls.

💡 100% Client-Side: Works on **multiplayer and singleplayer** worlds!!
